title: oenothera pallida subsp. runcinata
intro: Oenothera pallida subsp. runcinata, commonly known as the Pale Evening Primrose, is a perennial plant species native to North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce inflammation, and provide antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Oenothera pallida subsp. runcinata include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which may contribute to its potential benefits in treating conditions such as eczema and arthritis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and carotenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
